OPENCTI_URL.description: The base URL of the OpenCTI instance.

OPENCTI_TOKEN.description: The API token to connect to OpenCTI.

CONNECTOR_SCOPE.description: The OpenCTI entity types the connector enriches (files carrying an Android package).

CONNECTOR_LOG_LEVEL.description: The minimum level of logs to display.

CONNECTOR_AUTO.description: Whether the connector should run automatically when an entity is created or updated.

CONNECTOR_MAX_TLP.description: The highest TLP of the entities the connector is allowed to enrich. Entities marked with a higher TLP are skipped and never sent to the external source.

PRIVARA_UNMASK_API_KEY.description: Unmask API key (pvu_...) with the `submit` and `read` scopes. Create it at https://app.tajapps.com/dashboard/unmask/api (sign up at https://tajapps.com/unmask/).

PRIVARA_UNMASK_MAX_WAIT.description: Longest time in seconds to wait for one analysis before giving up (the analysis keeps running; enriching the file again within 24 hours picks up the same job at no extra cost).

PRIVARA_UNMASK_POLL_INTERVAL.description: First delay in seconds between two status checks when the API gives no Retry-After (it grows up to 120 s; never below 15 s).

PRIVARA_UNMASK_MAX_FILE_SIZE_MB.description: Optional lower size cap in MB. By default the API's own limit is used (GET /balance, limits.max_file_mb).

PRIVARA_UNMASK_CREATE_OBSERVABLES.description: Also create an observable (URL, IP, domain) for each C2 indicator.

PRIVARA_UNMASK_NOTIFY_EMAIL.description: Send the Privara result e-mail for each analysis (unset: the account's own setting).
